items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Aimorés (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Dec 1, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
